issue.body:
## Problem

The upload helper has its endpoint compiled in, so it cannot point at the staging server.

## Fix

`upload()` reads the endpoint from `SAMPLE_KIT_UPLOAD_URL` and the token from `SAMPLE_KIT_UPLOAD_TOKEN`. When either is unset it throws `set SAMPLE_KIT_UPLOAD_URL and SAMPLE_KIT_UPLOAD_TOKEN`.

## Done when

- [ ] Both values come from the environment, with no fallback.
- [ ] A test covers a missing variable.

pr.title: feat(sample-kit): read the upload endpoint and token from the environment
pr.body: Reads the upload endpoint and token from the environment, with a test for a missing variable.
